provider: Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier (ANDF) National Cadastre viewer and official GeoServer WFS, with Mairie de Bohicon portal reviewed separately
scope: Public national cadastral WFS was queried anonymously in bounded Bohicon envelopes. The municipal site is local custody evidence only for a public city portal, not for parcel geometry.
schemaAndCrs: efb:efb_parcel / view_parcel is Polygon with advertised EPSG:32631; GeoJSON was requested as EPSG:4326.
nativeIdentity: BJ.LA.SpatialUnit:spatial_unit_oid_local_id; source namespace and local ID were both returned. Repeated WFS feature IDs were not promoted.

fieldMapping.retained feature properties: id only; no raw attribute set.
fieldMapping.composite-key provenance: Namespace and local ID were source fields; ':' concatenation is the packet's canonical representation.

requestOutcome: Capabilities and viewer/configuration GETs returned 200. Bounded WFS query returned three full polygons with Bohicon context, and a smaller bbox around the exact WUP point returned three polygons. A follow-up identity-only request returned the three native IDs but no geometry because geometry was excluded.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: 200; current JS config exposed public GeoServer WFS route and layer name.
200; three polygons, Bohicon administrative fields observed; only geometry and native identity retained.
200; three polygons returned; exact point was preserved and not moved.

attemptedRoutes.url: https://geoserver.andf.bj/geoserver/efb/ows?service=WFS&version=1.0.0&request=GetFeature (same small bbox; propertyName native namespace/local ID only)
attemptedRoutes.outcome: 200; three native IDs, geometry null by intentional property selection.
200; local municipal services page, no public parcel endpoint identified.

officialCustodyEvidence: ANDF/GeoServer is the evidenced national geometry service. Mairie de Bohicon is a distinct local municipal portal; no city-specific public parcel API was evidenced.
retainedProperties: No raw source-specific attributes; each feature has only properties.id and full polygon geometry.
unsafeDataPolicy: No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal/property-record data retained.
limits: A small-bbox hit is not proof of citywide coverage.
No citywide completeness audit or municipal boundary intersection was performed.
Packet completion does not mean source integration/admission; runtime remains held until serial review.
uncertainty: Bounded official geometry and native IDs are verified, but coverage completeness, identity persistence, and adapter behavior remain independently unqualified.
